notes.title: Announcement of the next
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing "Brutal Alice and the Hundred Days War".

We'd like to announce the next game.

Development of the next game, "Brutal Alice and the Witches of the Lost Country (tentative title)" has started.
I'll be posting the latest information on Fanbox.
If you'd like to follow us, please do so.

Please follow us at https://koromosoft.fanbox.cc/

Fanbox also has a feature that users can help us with.
In the Koromosoft, we provide to the follow plan.

Regular Support Plan: 300 yen per month
Daishin Support Plan: 1,000 yen per month

We have two plans for you.
Please support this plan as well, if you would like.

The profit obtained by Fanbox will be used as a development fund.

That's all, thank you for your support of the Brutal Alice series from now on.
